name: WF-410 — Seller Property & Deal Data Enrichment Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const propertyId=String(b.propertyId??'').trim(); const address=String(b.address??b.propertyAddress??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,propertyId,address,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Property Enrichment Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const property=ctx.property??input.property??{}; const seller=ctx.seller??input.seller??{}; const deal=ctx.deal??input.deal??{}; const lead=ctx.lead??input.lead??{}; const numeric=(v)=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):null; const arv=numeric(property.arv??property.estimatedValue??ctx.arv); const repairs=numeric(property.repairs??ctx.repairs); const purchasePrice=numeric(deal.purchasePrice??deal.offerAmount); const assignmentFee=numeric(deal.assignmentFee); const equityPct=numeric(property.equityPercent??ctx.equityPercent); const sqft=numeric(property.sqft??property.squareFeet); const beds=numeric(property.beds??property.bedrooms); const baths=numeric(property.baths??property.bathrooms); const yearBuilt=numeric(property.yearBuilt); const ownershipYears=numeric(seller.ownershipYears); const occupancy=String(property.occupancy??seller.occupancy??'unknown').toLowerCase(); const propertyType=String(property.propertyType??property.type??'unknown').toLowerCase(); const distressSignals=Array.isArray(property.distressSignals)?property.distressSignals:[]; const missing=[]; for(const [k,v] of Object.entries({arv,repairs,purchasePrice,assignmentFee,equityPct,sqft,beds,baths,yearBuilt,ownershipYears})) if(v===null) missing.push(k); const dealSpread=arv!==null&&purchasePrice!==null?arv-purchasePrice:null; const estimatedGrossProfit=dealSpread!==null&&assignmentFee!==null?assignmentFee:dealSpread; const repairToValue=arv&&repairs!==null?repairs/arv:null; const enrichment={property:{propertyId:input.propertyId,address:input.address||property.address||null,propertyType,occupancy,sqft,beds,baths,yearBuilt},seller:{ownershipYears,ownerOccupied:occupancy==='owner_occupied'},deal:{purchasePrice,assignmentFee,arv,repairs,equityPercent:equityPct,dealSpread,estimatedGrossProfit,repairToValue},distress:{signals:distressSignals,count:distressSignals.length},lead:{source:lead.source??input.source??null,channel:lead.channel??input.channel??null},dataQuality:{missingFields:missing,completenessScore:Math.round(Math.max(0,100-(missing.length/10)*100))}}; const flags=[]; if(equityPct!==null&&equityPct>=40)flags.push('high_equity'); if(repairToValue!==null&&repairToValue>=0.2)flags.push('high_repair_burden'); if(occupancy==='vacant')flags.push('vacant'); if(distressSignals.length>0)flags.push('distress_signals'); if(ownershipYears!==null&&ownershipYears>=10)flags.push('long_ownership'); if(arv!==null&&purchasePrice!==null&&purchasePrice<arv*.7)flags.push('large_value_gap'); const status=missing.length<=2?'enriched':missing.length<=5?'partially_enriched':'insufficient_data'; const idempotencyKey='wf410:'+input.leadId+':'+input.propertyId; return [{json:{...input,context:ctx,enrichment:{status,enrichment,flags,sourceContext:'InsulaCRM canonical property/deal context'},idempotencyKey}}}];

meta.notes: Enrichment is a deterministic scaffold pending production property-data providers, verified InsulaCRM field mappings, and final API contract.
